001_N: ["New York, nineteen oh six. The best cook in town carries a deadly secret.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":1.1}]
003_N: ["A banker's summer house. Six of eleven fall sick.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":1.1}]
004_N: ["An investigator, George Soper, tracks down her old jobs.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":1.1}]
008_N: ["She chases him out with a carving fork.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":1.1}]
009_N: ["Then the police come. Mary hides for five hours.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":1.1}]
010_N: ["The tests are clear. She's full of typhoid germs.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":1.1}]
011_MARY: ["(angry) I've never been sick a day in my life!",{"fish":"29509e20f1a14a8698ffb42134fc944d","speed":1}]
012_N: ["True. She's a healthy carrier. The first one found in America.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":1.1}]
013_N: ["The papers call her Typhoid Mary. And they lock her on an island.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":1.1}]
014_N: ["Three years later, she's freed. On one condition: no more cooking.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":1.1}]
015_N: ["So she becomes Mary Brown. A cook. At a maternity hospital.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":1.1}]
017_N: ["Back to the island. For twenty-three years. Until she dies.",{"fish":"0327fdb5da9e4fd782899a8058c8ae2b","speed":1.1}]
